short: Quantum-Dot Sensitized Solar Cells Employing Hierarchical Cu
title: Quantum-Dot Sensitized Solar Cells Employing Hierarchical Cu2S Microspheres Wrapped by Reduced Graphene Oxide Nanosheets as Effective Counter Electrodes

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Wrapping hierarchical Cu2S microspheres in reduced graphene oxide should make a more effective QDSSC counter electrode than Pt or bare Cu2S. Hierarchical Cu2S microspheres as the catalytic counter-electrode material.
states.detail: Absorbed: b1 (HYP/hypothesis), b2 (DES/base_system), b3 (DES/modification), b4 (DES/variable_sweep), b5 (PRC/synthesis)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Cu2S forms flower-like microspheres of ~2-3 um assembled from thin curved nanoflakes. RGO sheets wrap and bridge the microspheres, coverage rising with loading until -3 buries them.

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Electrocatalytic activity for polysulfide reduction ranks RGO-Cu2S-2 > Cu2S >> Pt. Conductive RGO sheets link the Cu2S microspheres and add accessible surface, speeding electron transfer to catalytic Cu2S sites

states.title: Performance state
states.head: QDSSC with RGO-Cu2S-2 counter electrode gives the highest Jsc (~16 mA/cm2) and Voc (~0.555 V) of the three electrodes

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: RGO-wrapped hierarchical Cu2S is a more active, Pt-free QDSSC counter electrode that raises photocurrent over Cu2S and Pt

nodes.title: MICRO, F1, F2
nodes.head: Flower-like ~2-3 um microspheres built from thin curved flakes, flakes protruding at the rims. Thin nanoflake edges of only a few nm thickness, overlapping, at the rim of a microsphere
nodes.solves: Cu2S forms flower-like microspheres of ~2-3 um assembled from thin curved nanoflakes
nodes.note: 2 um main scale bar, 500 nm inset; bare Cu2S particles look like ~2-3 um discs with a smooth outer skin and a tuft of flakes protruding, not fully flake-built spheres (those appear in the F1b-d insets) 50 nm scale bar; the lighter edge layer measures roughly 8-10 nm, so 'a few nm' is at the low end; flakes overlap so individual thickness is not measurable
nodes.necessity_reason: No member reaches image_support shown and b6 has no other figure-backed support.

nodes.title: MICRO, F1
nodes.head: Crumpled sheets drape over and between spheres; few in b (circled), more in c, nearly covering spheres in d
nodes.solves: RGO sheets wrap and bridge the microspheres, coverage rising with loading until -3 buries them
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for b8 (q6).

nodes.title: TEM, F2
nodes.head: Thin, faint sheets extend beyond the edge of a dense ~4 um particle in TEM
nodes.solves: RGO sheets wrap and bridge the microspheres, coverage rising with loading until -3 buries them
nodes.note: the sheets are visible mainly outside the particle outline; wrapping over the dense core cannot be resolved
nodes.necessity_reason: No member reaches image_support shown, and b8 keeps shown support from q6.

nodes.title: evidence, F3, F4
nodes.head: GO bands at 1726, 1628, 1171, 1068 and 3411 cm-1 are absent or much weaker for RGO-Cu2S. C-O component falls from about equal to C-C in GO to about half of C-C in RGO-Cu2S-2.
nodes.solves: GO is reduced during the solvothermal step: oxygen groups largely removed and sp2 carbon restored
nodes.note: RGO-Cu2S retains a weak feature near 1600-1650 cm-1; Cu2S is featureless the O-C=O component is relatively larger in RGO-Cu2S-2 than in GO, so reduction is partial D (1335) and G bands are both much stronger for RGO-Cu2S with D/G near 1 vs ~0.7 for GO; 2D and D+G features at 2705-3136 cm-1 appear on a rising background
nodes.detail: q8: GO bands at 1726, 1628, 1171, 1068 and 3411 cm-1 are absent or much weaker for RGO-Cu2S; q9: C-O component falls from about equal to C-C in GO to about half of C-C in RGO-Cu2S-2; q10: Graphene G band sits at 1583 cm-1 in RGO-Cu2S vs 1604 cm-1 in GO
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for b9 (q8, q9, q10).

nodes.title: PHYS:surfacearea, F3
nodes.head: RGO-Cu2S adsorbs more N2 at every P/P0 (~53 vs ~32 cm3/g near saturation) with more 3-15 nm pores
nodes.solves: RGO-Cu2S-2 has more mesopore volume and N2 uptake than bare Cu2S
nodes.note: both isotherms show hysteresis above P/P0 ~0.8; pore-size maxima near ~20 nm for both
nodes.detail: q12: RGO-Cu2S adsorbs more N2 at every P/P0 (~53 vs ~32 cm3/g near saturation) with more 3-15 nm pores
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for b10 (q12).

nodes.title: DIFF, F3
nodes.head: All RGO-Cu2S patterns repeat the Cu2S reflections (-104, 132, 041, 141, 532) with no extra peak
nodes.note: peak intensities drop for RGO-Cu2S-3 relative to the others
nodes.necessity_reason: b12 keeps shown support from q3, q4, q11 after removal.

nodes.title: TEM:SAED, XRD, F2, F4
nodes.head: Lattice fringes with 0.19 nm spacing in a nanoflake. SAED spot pattern with spots indexed (132) and (532).
nodes.note: 0.19 nm matches d for the XRD (532) reflection at ~47.8 deg 2theta (Cu K-alpha), consistent across panels discrete spots rather than rings: single-crystalline region panel c labels are swapped: the ~932 eV peak is labelled Cu 2p1/2 and ~952 eV Cu 2p3/2 (2p3/2 is the lower binding energy line)
nodes.detail: q3: Lattice fringes with 0.19 nm spacing in a nanoflake; q4: SAED spot pattern with spots indexed (132) and (532); q11: Cu 2p peaks at ~932 and ~952 eV with no shake-up satellite, Cu LMM near 570 eV, S 2p at ~162 eV
nodes.necessity_reason: b12 keeps shown support from q5 after removal.

nodes.title: ECHEM:Tafel, F6
nodes.head: Symmetric-cell charge-transfer arcs: ~2500 Ohm for Pt, ~11 Ohm for Cu2S, ~3.5 Ohm for RGO-Cu2S. Tafel curves: log J at +/-0.3 V ~1.4 (RGO-Cu2S) > ~1.2 (Cu2S) >> ~0.25 (Pt), with steeper branches near 0 V.
nodes.solves: Electrocatalytic activity for polysulfide reduction ranks RGO-Cu2S-2 > Cu2S >> Pt
nodes.op: compare across conditions, compare with reference value
nodes.note: Rs ~7.3-8.2 Ohm for all; RGO-Cu2S shows two small arcs matching the drawn Rs-(Rct1/CPE1)-(Rct2/CPE2) circuit; Cu2S arc not closed at 16 Ohm
nodes.detail: q13: Symmetric-cell charge-transfer arcs: ~2500 Ohm for Pt, ~11 Ohm for Cu2S, ~3.5 Ohm for RGO-Cu2S; q14: Tafel curves: log J at +/-0.3 V ~1.4 (RGO-Cu2S) > ~1.2 (Cu2S) >> ~0.25 (Pt), with steeper branches near 0 V; q15: Cu2S and RGO-Cu2S give cathodic peaks of ~-42 mA/cm2 near -1.25 V; Pt reaches only ~-0.4 mA/cm2; q16: RGO-Cu2S and Cu2S CVs nearly overlap: cathodic peaks differ by <5% and Cu2S reaches the higher anodic current
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for b11 (q13, q14, q15, q16).

nodes.title: UVVIS:IPCE, F5
nodes.head: Jsc ~16.0, ~15.0, ~13.0 mA/cm2 and Voc ~0.555, ~0.535, ~0.53 V for RGO-Cu2S, Cu2S and Pt. IPCE ranks RGO-Cu2S > Cu2S > Pt across 320-620 nm, peaking ~94%, ~88%, ~65% at ~340 nm
nodes.solves: QDSSC with RGO-Cu2S-2 counter electrode gives the highest Jsc (~16 mA/cm2) and Voc (~0.555 V) of the three electrodes
nodes.op: compare across conditions, compare with reference value, read characteristic point
nodes.note: Pt curve is least square, so its fill factor is also lowest; no PCE value is shown all curves cut off at ~640 nm, the sensitiser edge; IPCE ranking agrees with the Jsc ranking in F5a
nodes.detail: q17: Jsc ~16.0, ~15.0, ~13.0 mA/cm2 and Voc ~0.555, ~0.535, ~0.53 V for RGO-Cu2S, Cu2S and Pt; q18: IPCE ranks RGO-Cu2S > Cu2S > Pt across 320-620 nm, peaking ~94%, ~88%, ~65% at ~340 nm
